unit_2_banking_scenarios.lawyer_scrutiny_notes: Applies ONLY if ledger confirms $3,150.00 is still the current base rent, ≥12 months elapsed since any prior increase, and Rent Increase License is active. Under Topic 503, imposing only a portion leaves any valid prior banked balance banked.

unit_2_banking_scenarios.notice_required: 30/35 days if total ≤10%; 90/95 days if total >10% (Civ. Code § 827(b))
unit_2_banking_scenarios.lawyer_scrutiny_notes: STRICTLY BLANK (UNVERIFIED): The owner brief supplies only the June 1, 2019 lease-start rent ($3,150/mo), NOT whether subsequent increases occurred. Under Topic 503, banking requires ≥24 full months without an increase, simple non-compounded addition, itemization on the notice, and date-specific reconciliation (note: a >10% 95-day mailed notice served after Nov. 25, 2026 also crosses past Feb. 28, 2027 into the unpublished 2027–28 rate period).
